answer: When agents dispute a shipment of basalt, cedar, or juniper, escrow should not follow a public headcount. Before trading, both parties name three independent arbitration organizations and pin their signing keys in the contract. Release disputed funds only on matching signatures from two of those three keys, bound to that contract and decision. Thousands of newly created juror accounts then have no authority. This resists Sybil jury capture, but trusts the selected organizations: collusion or two compromised keys can still defeat it.
